que_es: Sobrantes de laminas reales de dos canales, para la confirmacion fisica de la recomendacion 3 de progress/review_F5.7.md y para el criterio de texto de F5.9. Narracion del guion y marcas del alineador tal cual salieron del run; los .wav no hacen falta porque un sobrante se confirma con la ventana de sus propias marcas. CUATRO casos son reales y UNO esta fabricado —`divaga_de_verdad`, que lo dice en su propio `que_es`— porque en los 16 runs producidos no queda ninguna divagacion real con la que probar que el gate todavia sabe reportar una.

habla_de_verdad.que_es: NO era un sobrante real, y el nombre del caso se conserva para que no se pierda la correccion (F5.9). F5.7 lo dio por habla de verdad porque su ritmo cuadra: 20 palabras en 10,72 s = 0,536 s por palabra, y el canal narra a 0,53. El 18-09 se comprobo por oido y es un duplicado del reconocedor: transcribiendo los 10-38 s del slide-07.wav archivado en UNA sola ventana de whisper —sin ventana deslizante, o sea sin el artefacto— la frase «and then her arm was tired too biscuit watched them from the door» sale UNA vez, y en el guion esta UNA vez. La alineacion del run tiene su salto atras en 29,98 -> 20,0 s, justo encima. Hoy lo descarta F5.9 por texto, no por ritmo. **De donde salen sus marcas**: de la alineacion de `limpieza/`, no de la de `subtitulos/` que el gate prefiere — 194 marcas en `slide-07` contra 174—, y son una FOTO: el fichero de hoy ya no es identico porque el run se retoco despues. Por eso este tramo no aparece al revisar el run ahora.
habla_de_verdad.narracion: They mixed everything with a big wooden spoon. It was hard work. The mix did not want to move. Ollie mixed for two minutes, and then his arm was tired. Nora took the spoon and mixed for two minutes, and then her arm was tired too. Biscuit watched them from the door. He was still white. He was waiting for something to fall on the floor. Nothing fell. Biscuit was very disappointed. They put the mix in a round tin. Ollie opened the oven. It was warm inside. Nora put the tin in, very carefully, with both hands. Ollie closed the oven. The two children looked at each other. They had done it. Nora said, "Now we wait. Forty minutes." Then Ollie looked around the kitchen... and he remembered the other half of the plan. Ollie said, "Now we clean. Fast." He took a cloth. He put water on it. He started to clean the table. This was a mistake. Flour and water do not make a clean table. Flour and water make glue.

solape_mums.que_es: Artefacto: 47 palabras ('mums' 27 veces y luego texto repetido) en una ventana de 0,34 s = 138 palabras/s. La alineacion retrocede de 89,98 s a 80,0 s en marcas[223]: es el solape de la ventana deslizante del reconocedor, no audio.
solape_mums.narracion: Mum asked, "Is that flour on the dog?" Ollie said, "Yes. That is flour on the dog." Mum asked, "And is there a cake in the oven?" Nora said, "Yes. It's for you. It might be a bad cake. We only had one and a half eggs." Mum sat down on a white chair, and she laughed and laughed. Then she stood up and hugged them both. And now Mum was white too. Mum said, "¡It's the best present in the world! But now we clean this kitchen together. All of us. Right now." Dad came in from the garden. He looked at the kitchen. He looked at his white family. Dad said, "I was outside for twenty minutes." So they cleaned. All four of them... and one very happy dog who did not help at all. First the brush, and then the water. In that order. And forty minutes later, they ate the cake in the garden. It was a little flat, and a little hard on one side. Mum said it was delicious. She said it twice.

solape_bridle.que_es: Artefacto del otro canal: 19 palabras en una ventana NEGATIVA (-0,28 s), porque la ventana se mide a caballo del salto de 29,9 s a 20,0 s de marcas[72].
solape_bridle.narracion: Nobody had to be told what it meant... and that is the efficiency of it. Not one person in that square needed it explained. A fine has to be written down to exist. A whipping has to be watched to be believed. But a person standing in the square in an iron mask carries the verdict on her face. All afternoon. <sigh> For everyone who walks past without stopping... and for everyone who does.

repite_el_guion.que_es: Sobrante REAL que el filtro de ritmo NO caza (F5.9): 19 palabras en 10,47 s = 0,551 s por palabra, que es el ritmo del canal (1,885 palabras/s = 0,53 s por palabra). Cabe hablado, pero su texto es el de la propia narracion de la lamina repetido: 89,5 % de coincidencia palabra a palabra. Lo que se duplico fue la transcripcion, no el audio.
repite_el_guion.narracion: Ollie sat down on the grass with the stick in his hands. He was quiet for a moment. He was thinking. Then he stood up, and he had that face... the face he always had before a bad idea. <chuckle> Ollie said, "If I can't reach it, I can throw this." Nora said, "No. Please don't do that." Ollie said, "Yes. I can do it." Nora said, "No, Ollie. Listen to me." But Ollie was already throwing it. The stick went up. It went up really well, actually. It went past the kite, very close to it, and everybody looked up with their mouths open. And then the stick came down again, into the grass, two metres away. Biscuit ran after it and brought it back, because that is what Biscuit does with sticks. It is his job. Ollie threw it a second time. Down it came, and Biscuit brought it back again. Then he threw it a third time... and the stick did not come down. It stayed up there, on the branch, next to the kite. Nora looked at her brother. Nora said, "Now there are two things in the tree."

divaga_de_verdad.que_es: CONTROL POSITIVO FABRICADO (F5.9), y se dice que lo es. Son las marcas reales de `habla_de_verdad` con el texto de sus 20 palabras cambiado por una despedida que el guion NO dice, y los tiempos intactos: 0,536 s por palabra, ritmo de narracion. Existe porque en los 16 runs producidos no hay ni una divagacion real que sobreviva al recorte por texto, asi que el gate se quedaria sin nada que probara que todavia sabe reportar una. Hereda las marcas de `habla_de_verdad`, o sea las de `limpieza/`. Su `cubierto` es 0,25 frente a un umbral de 0,80: demuestra que el criterio sabe decir «divaga», NO donde esta su raya — eso lo fija `test_la_frontera_EXACTA_del_80_por_ciento` con 0,833 y 0,789.
